decisions.reason: The supplied September 30 publication date falls within September 16–October 15. Accept as a new controlled comparison useful for choosing student experiment baselines, not proof that harnesses never help. The authors report matched backbones, hardware and budgets; GLM 5.2 self-selected medal rates are 62.5% for Malena versus 47.1% for AiScientist ([saved text, §3 and D.2, Tables 15–16](data/assets/7f0901064878a294934bd154/6c598d9a3db4f487a0045a147e48bc3e4064e2b81bf388f4ac0947b9d96c78ec/text.txt#:~:text=D.2%20Detailed%20MLE-bench%20results)). Preserve exceptions: Gemma significantly favors MLEvolve on percentile, and failure to detect a difference does not establish equivalence. Ablations use original default29 tasks, whereas external comparisons use repaired fixed30 tasks; NatureBench permits unlimited evaluation queries and reports oracle best scores, so it is not an independent untouched-test confirmation ([A.1–A.3 and D.6](data/assets/7f0901064878a294934bd154/6c598d9a3db4f487a0045a147e48bc3e4064e2b81bf388f4ac0947b9d96c78ec/text.txt#:~:text=D.6%20NatureBench)). Cost claims require separation of the experiment worker from eight-GPU backbone hosting and modeled cache charges; minimal architecture does not mean cheapest inference ([A.4 and §5.1](data/assets/7f0901064878a294934bd154/6c598d9a3db4f487a0045a147e48bc3e4064e2b81bf388f4ac0947b9d96c78ec/text.txt#:~:text=A.4%20LLM%20backbones%20used)). The preprint supplies implementation details and repair diffs, but no independent replication is supplied. The affiliation header identifies EPFL/Apple and Apple internship work; authors evaluate their own system and acknowledge tuning asymmetry, contamination risk and only 3–4 seeds for 24-hour runs ([G.1](data/assets/7f0901064878a294934bd154/6c598d9a3db4f487a0045a147e48bc3e4064e2b81bf388f4ac0947b9d96c78ec/text.txt#:~:text=G.1%20Limitations)). Editorial implication: start with a simple baseline, protect evaluation data and measure total cost before adding orchestration.

The supplied October 2 publication date is eligible; October 9 is an update, not a separate demonstrated development. Accept for scrutiny of research-plan evaluation and inspectable proposal design, not demonstrated experimental success. The substantive contribution combines staged ideation with actual LoRA/GRPO weight training; the proposal schema includes baselines, ablations and falsification conditions ([§3.2 and A.2, Table 5](data/assets/7f93d63faaf11f733276a443/1c8d31d1a52853a33abbf82a2909b64babf8ea03d6714eb54e2df4ed7128e44a/text.txt#:~:text=3.2%20Training%20Design)). Correct the headline: 74.6 versus 60.6 is 14.0 score points, while training adds only 1.1 points over the 73.5 base harness. The 14,977 papers include 14,500 training targets and only 277 test targets, not 15K independent evaluation cases ([§4.2 and Table 1](data/assets/7f93d63faaf11f733276a443/1c8d31d1a52853a33abbf82a2909b64babf8ea03d6714eb54e2df4ed7128e44a/text.txt#:~:text=4.2%20Training%20data%20construction)). Appendix C defines in-domain novelty as binary cross-setting transfer, making the aggregate partly reward the system's intended design rather than establish scientific novelty. Human comparisons cover 50 papers and do not significantly favor Trained over Base or DeepScientist ([§5.2 and Appendix C](data/assets/7f93d63faaf11f733276a443/1c8d31d1a52853a33abbf82a2909b64babf8ea03d6714eb54e2df4ed7128e44a/text.txt#:~:text=Human-annotation-based%20win-rate)). External systems lack matched caps; training uses 40 eight-H100 nodes per role, limiting student reproducibility. Retrieval cutoff does not exclude model-memory contamination. E.1 says test data were used only for final evaluation, but F.4 compares checkpoint combinations on the full test split: selection independence needs clarification ([E.1–E.2 and F.4](data/assets/7f93d63faaf11f733276a443/1c8d31d1a52853a33abbf82a2909b64babf8ea03d6714eb54e2df4ed7128e44a/text.txt#:~:text=F.4%20Checkpoint%20Selection)). This is an author-run preprint evaluation with shared model roles in artifact construction and judging, not independent replication; financial conflicts are not established in the supplied text. Code/data links are supplied, but their completeness is unverified. Students can adopt the proposal checklist while testing feasibility themselves; ideation scores do not contradict the separate MLE execution study.

The supplied October 1 publication date is eligible, but this is a study-aid prompting tutorial rather than evidence about autonomous computational experiments. Its concrete demonstration is an author's puppy-training quiz followed by 37 flashcards; no controlled learning outcomes, validated diagnostic accuracy, execution logs or research-agent evaluation are supplied ([saved text, 'As a test' passage](data/assets/810ca788d6580a6871563f4d/2ec6998b1c53899734b6cb244fefc18311d1635c79e90220c4b2743ae1235252/text.txt#:~:text=As%20a%20test)). Under policy v2, this could establish an operational flashcard procedure, not the headline's superiority claim or the assertion that users will know exactly where their knowledge gaps are. The prompt and accompanying skill offer a workflow, but no demonstrated novelty relevant to experimental automation. The author explicitly promotes a paid-subscriber skill, creating a direct commercial interest ([saved text, 'Dig deeper' and subscription passages](data/assets/810ca788d6580a6871563f4d/2ec6998b1c53899734b6cb244fefc18311d1635c79e90220c4b2743ae1235252/text.txt#:~:text=Dig%20deeper)). General usefulness to students does not make it useful to this series; inaccessible paid material is not the decisive issue.

The supplied October 8 publication date is eligible. Accept as new evidence about prioritizing experiments using recorded outcomes, with practical relevance to preserving failed runs and testing selection policies. The authors report 2,653 experimental records, held-out intervention forecasts, kNN/ridge controls and exclusion of near-duplicate intervention groups in cross-environment histories ([§3.1–3.2](data/assets/813b9149789f0913c5bfb94d/4e9fb103fdae9cf7e73a08394a425933da944a26fb69499d2c2935840571b3d8/text.txt#:~:text=3.1%20Experimental%20Setup)). This uses fixed model weights and in-context records, not newly trained world-model weights ([§2.2–2.3](data/assets/813b9149789f0913c5bfb94d/4e9fb103fdae9cf7e73a08394a425933da944a26fb69499d2c2935840571b3d8/text.txt#:~:text=2.2%20LLMs%20as%20Research%20World%20Models)). Preserve counterexamples: Marin selection worsens despite improved ranking, inference-selection regret favors simpler controls, and transfer-correlation intervals include zero for Marin and OLMo3-190M ([Tables 4–5 and D.1](data/assets/813b9149789f0913c5bfb94d/4e9fb103fdae9cf7e73a08394a425933da944a26fb69499d2c2935840571b3d8/text.txt#:~:text=D.1%20Uncertainty%20in%20cross-environment%20predictions)). The reported 15.8%/11.6% multi-round gains concern five evaluations selecting from pre-existing candidates with measured outcomes; they do not demonstrate unrestricted live discovery. Initial histories are outside the 24-selection budget ([E.1–E.3](data/assets/813b9149789f0913c5bfb94d/4e9fb103fdae9cf7e73a08394a425933da944a26fb69499d2c2935840571b3d8/text.txt#:~:text=E.1%20Candidate%20sampling%20and%20arrivals)). The $6.3 scoring estimate excludes acquiring the archive, reported as 171,862 H100 GPU-hours; students must assess savings against their own experiment costs ([§3.3, 'Prediction cost', and Table 1](data/assets/813b9149789f0913c5bfb94d/4e9fb103fdae9cf7e73a08394a425933da944a26fb69499d2c2935840571b3d8/text.txt#:~:text=Prediction%20cost)). Full methodological text is supplied, but artifact release remains prospective, commercial API predictions are not bitwise reproducible, and no independent replication or external researcher assessment is supplied. Authors generated the experimental records themselves; financial affiliations/conflicts are unresolved in this evidence ([Ethics and Reproducibility statements](data/assets/813b9149789f0913c5bfb94d/4e9fb103fdae9cf7e73a08394a425933da944a26fb69499d2c2935840571b3d8/text.txt#:~:text=Ethics%20statement)). Use as a qualified preprint finding and rationale for small prospective tests, not an established general efficiency gain.
